gh:
#!/bin/sh
count=$(/bin/cat '<place>/gh/count')
count=$((count + 1))
printf '%s\n' "$count" > '<place>/gh/count'
{
  printf 'call %s\n' "$count"
  for argument in "$@"; do printf 'argument %s\n' "$argument"; done
  printf 'GH_DEBUG %s\n' "${GH_DEBUG-<unset>}"
  printf 'GH_PROMPT_DISABLED %s\n' "${GH_PROMPT_DISABLED-<unset>}"
  printf 'GH_HOST %s\n' "${GH_HOST-<unset>}"
  printf 'GH_PAGER %s\n' "${GH_PAGER-<unset>}"
  printf 'TRIAGE_KEPT %s\n' "${TRIAGE_KEPT-<unset>}"
} >> '<place>/gh/log'
/bin/cat > "<place>/gh/input.$count"
answer="<place>/gh/answers/$count"
if [ ! -f "$answer.status" ]; then exit 97; fi
if [ -f "$answer.effect" ]; then /bin/cp "$answer.effect" "$(/bin/cat "$answer.target")"; fi
if [ -f "$answer.stdout" ]; then /bin/cat "$answer.stdout"; fi
if [ -f "$answer.stderr" ]; then /bin/cat "$answer.stderr" >&2; fi
if [ -f "$answer.sleep" ]; then /bin/sleep "$(/bin/cat "$answer.sleep")"; fi
exit "$(/bin/cat "$answer.status")"
